rollRule: Weighted draw without replacement by family (a higher weight is more common; the standard templates use 100, powerhouses 3-8); typed variants selected after family; inclusive integer values.

affixes.name: Type Focus
affixes.condition: Move has the selected type

affixes.name: Physical Force
affixes.condition: Move is physical

affixes.name: Special Force
affixes.condition: Move is special

affixes.name: Healthy Force
affixes.condition: User HP is at least 80% before move

affixes.name: Last Stand
affixes.condition: User HP is at most 35% before move

affixes.name: Defiant Force
affixes.condition: User has a nonvolatile status before move; does not remove native status penalties

affixes.name: Type Ward
affixes.condition: Incoming move has selected type

affixes.name: Healthy Guard
affixes.condition: Holder HP is at least 80% before incoming move

affixes.name: Steadfast Guard
affixes.condition: Holder HP is at most 35% before incoming move

affixes.name: Status Guard
affixes.condition: Holder has a nonvolatile status before incoming move

affixes.name: Opening Guard
affixes.condition: First incoming damaging move that deals direct damage this battle; all its hits share reduction

affixes.name: Restorative
affixes.condition: Self-recovery or drain caused by holder's move; excludes items, abilities, residual and ally healing

affixes.name: Type Mastery
affixes.condition: Move has the selected type (one of the Pokemon's current types); rare, replaces Type Focus because they share a family

affixes.name: Overwhelming Force
affixes.condition: Every damaging move; very rare

affixes.name: Kindred Force
affixes.condition: Move type matches one of the user's current types

affixes.name: Executioner
affixes.condition: Target HP is at most 50% before the move

affixes.name: Opening Strike
affixes.condition: User's first damaging move after entering battle; all its hits share the bonus

affixes.name: Super Effective Force
affixes.condition: Move is super effective against the target by native type effectiveness

affixes.name: Iron Resolve
affixes.condition: Every incoming damaging move; very rare

affixes.name: Type Bulwark
affixes.condition: Incoming move has selected type; rare, replaces Type Ward because they share a family

affixes.name: Resilient Hide
affixes.condition: Incoming move is super effective against the holder by native type effectiveness

affixes.name: Triumphant
affixes.condition: Holder's direct move faints the target; restores a percentage of the holder's maximum HP once per faint; no recursive triggers; excludes items, abilities, residual and ally healing

affixes.name: Physical Bulwark
affixes.condition: Incoming move is physical

affixes.name: Special Bulwark
affixes.condition: Incoming move is special

affixes.name: Smoldering
affixes.condition: Burn damage on a target this Pokemon burned; no second burn is applied

affixes.name: Venomous
affixes.condition: Regular poison damage on a target this Pokemon poisoned; toxic is excluded

affixes.name: Rending
affixes.condition: 30% chance on a damaging hit to cause bleeding (1/12 max HP a turn per stack, up to 3 stacks, 3 turns); the percent boosts the bleed
